views.zh: 解决自动驾驶靠的是 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破；纯摄像头可达人类水平，雷达与激光雷达才能超越人类。

views.en: Generalization is the core: diverse data, world models, and zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities without prior training data.
views.zh: 泛化是核心：多样数据、世界模型，以及在 500 多个城市无需先验训练数据的零样本泛化。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors outscale robotaxis.
views.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要；带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; safety always offers a third minimal-risk option.
views.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理与个性化；安全上始终存在第三条最小风险的选项。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat AI models well even if their moral status is uncertain; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
views.zh: 即便不确定模型的道德地位，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychological analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型有时反而比新模型更有心理安全感。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can still adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；拥有良好特质的核心身份，仍可适应局部角色。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般、独特的特质。

views.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要更少显式规则、更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

views.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability; models should be treated with respect to avoid breeding future resentment.
views.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化对问责至关重要；应以尊重对待模型，以免在未来先进 AI 中滋生怨恨。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL overcomes the pre-training data wall with synthetic data.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling，用合成数据突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must evolve.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准测试的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须持续演进。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective art, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练仍是主观艺术，需要人类判断；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
views.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体越来越会奖励黑客；基准测试应是连续的而非固定的，以跟上模型能力。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出向数十亿人提供单一模型会收敛为平均默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

views.en: Happiness is the absence of desire; wealth requires owning equity, not renting out your time.
views.zh: 2019 至 2020 年，他反复强调幸福源于欲望的缺席，财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，这条主线贯穿始终。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI is crucial.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度明显转向：视其为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，Vibe Coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件工程正走向消亡。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency matters more than intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 90000 倍，开源模型与前沿模型差距缩小到 3-6 个月，人类的回报将从智能转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
views.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；编程用 GUI 优于 TUI，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, letting model-driven actions replace deterministic steps.
views.zh: 53 版 Codex 的速度带来实时交互与中途转向，让模型驱动的动作取代确定性步骤。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties persist; the same product shape succeeds or fails on model timing, not features.
views.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工仍在；同样的产品形态成败取决于模型时机，而非功能。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs act as operating systems, RL as low-level control.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能为知识提供落地经验、减少幻觉；LLM 像操作系统，强化学习负责低层控制。

views.en: The internet is running out of high-quality tokens for pre-training, but embodied worlds supply infinite data.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出互联网的高质量 token 正被预训练耗尽，而具身世界能提供近乎无限的数据。

views.en: Simulation and synthetic data are the scalable path to training embodied agents, enabling parallel, safe exploration.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调仿真与合成数据是可扩展地训练具身智能体的路径，支持大规模并行与安全探索。

views.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的核心瓶颈，认为经由仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model is key; the physical Turing test and system one control remain hardest.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张简洁的端到端机器人基础模型是关键，物理图灵测试与 system one 低层控制仍是最难的部分。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style scaling curves; the core challenge is generalization, and demos hide how little is truly generalized.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出,机器人尚未像大语言模型那样拥有可预测的缩放定律曲线,核心难题是泛化,而演示往往掩盖了真实泛化程度之低。

views.en: Robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; high-quality post-training alone fails without broad pre-training.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调,机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练;仅有高质量后训练数据,缺乏广泛预训练,就无法应对各种恢复场景。

views.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video on top — not the reverse.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张,应先从真实具身机器人数据出发,再叠加人类视频等其他数据源,而非反过来。

views.en: Pooling data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists; a deployed-robot data flywheel drives capability.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为,汇聚多实验室的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型,而部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是能力提升的关键。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出,机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识,而非硬性约束;未来应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理驱动,而非机械式的人形机器人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress in coming years.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来数年加速 AI 进步。

views.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge as systems grow more powerful; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
views.zh: 随着系统能力增强，对齐成为紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early.
views.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 努力追求的重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计。

views.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close.
views.zh: 衡量能力正成为瓶颈，基准落后于模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近它。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现；思维链监控是关键的 对齐 工具。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
views.zh: 长期 对齐 的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

views.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
views.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性而非单纯体量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，以提升成功率与速度。

views.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than to simulation.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非传统仿真。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性依赖带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior.
views.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈则引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行长时任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件才是真正的瓶颈，推理已占数据中心九成功耗。

views.en: Context engineering, clear specs, and retrieval let capable models do real work; taste, not coding, becomes the scarce skill.
views.zh: 上下文工程、清晰规格与检索让有能力的模型真正干活；稀缺技能不再是写代码，而是选择把数百个智能体指向哪个问题的品味。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery; small teams using cloud can beat big labs.
views.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法可加速科学发现；善用云算力的小团队，反而可能胜过大型实验室。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue and unforeseen applications remain the killer app; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, while product managers misunderstand generality.
views.zh: 对话与不可预见的应用始终是杀手级应用；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，产品经理常误解技术的通用性。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and trillion-token context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展与万亿级上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构支撑高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: AI safety needs engineering safeguards and human oversight; models should learn by acting in the world, with continual learning replacing monolithic retraining.
views.zh: AI 安全需要工程保障与人类监督；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，持续学习将取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, coding is underhyped, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
views.zh: 仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，编程被低估，AGI 的经济影响也被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，自我博弈在非零和领域失效。

views.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence, with general techniques beyond math.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是可泛化的测试时算力技术，而非数学专用模型。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也需计入该预算。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
views.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先项，思维链监控窗口正在退化，多智能体并行扩展测试时算力。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
views.zh: 2025 年他认为：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上算力 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理基础，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware and artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity, not screen-bound software.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人、硬件媲美人体，以及靠好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家，而非屏幕后的软件。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 同期他更明确地反共识：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身分歧、AI 会自设目标；AI 安全担忧被夸大，好奇的智能体会保护生命。

views.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
views.zh: 他持续警告：万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜得多；开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河，递归自我改进并非可持续壁垒。

views.en: Since 1965 deep learning began in Ukraine; AI is civilization-scale, consciousness emerges from predictive world models, and compute democratizes to the little guy.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习始于 1965 年的乌克兰；AI 是文明级集体工程；意识从预测性世界模型中涌现；算力终将像手机一样普及，受益者是小人物。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but simulation and self-play can teach complex tasks like tennis.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；但通过模拟和自对弈，机器人可以学会网球等复杂任务。

views.en: Unsupervised learning combined with RL improves sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
views.zh: 2021 年，他转向强调无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；并指出 99.9%的可靠性是仓库机器人创造价值的关键。

views.en: Consistent belief: simulation and transfer from pre-trained models enable real-world robot learning; language models internalize general reasoning patterns.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他一以贯之地相信模拟和从预训练模型迁移能实现真实世界的机器人学习；并认为语言模型内化了可迁移的通用推理模式。

views.en: Deepened view: a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, and minimally adapted language models can perform image classification and protein binding prediction.
views.zh: 2021 年，他的观点深化：单个神经网络可以泛化到不同的仓库任务和末端执行器；经过最小适配的语言模型能执行图像分类和蛋白质结合预测。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%可年化复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润率。

views.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型走向专业化并具有独特个性，而非商品化。

views.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你做事；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具与设备的编排是关键。

views.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代工作，但人类将在好奇心与关系中找到新目标。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the real challenge is human-agent product interface design.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程将让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战在于设计人机协作的产品界面。

views.en: Software engineering demand will increase via Jevons paradox, not decrease; AI will create more programmers, not fewer.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件工程需求会因杰文斯悖论而增加而非减少；AI 会创造更多程序员，而不是消灭程序员。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件，进步是渐进的；企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption, growing 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体被大规模采用，六个月内使用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他宣称丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫在眉睫。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不真正好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models alongside frontier models are essential for speed, cost, and quality.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把编辑器重新定义为 AI 集成的开发环境，并深化为：自研模型与前沿模型并用，对速度、成本与产品质量都不可或缺。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类始终坐在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力比小心谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is far bigger because AI enables more value creation.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定性为比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开，并认为 AI 带来更多价值创造，使 IDE 市场远大于过去的编辑器市场。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play and small experiments build intuition.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，通过玩耍和小实验建立直觉，而非复杂编排。

views.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
views.zh: 同期他提出反共识：永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差。

views.en: OpenClaw succeeds by being fun, weird, humanlike; short prompts and iterative conversation beat long orchestration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他深化为：OpenClaw 的成功来自有趣、怪异、像人，短提示和迭代对话胜过冗长编排。

views.en: Security is top priority: sandbox agents, don't expose to public internet; prompt injection remains open.
views.zh: 同期他把安全提到首位：智能体必须沙箱化，不能暴露在公网；提示注入仍是未解问题。

views.en: Fun and gut drive building; personal brand beats any product; open source runs anywhere, any model.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他转向更宏观的驱动：乐趣和直觉驱动创造，个人品牌胜过单一产品，开源可运行于任何模型。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；自博弈能产生创造性解法，神经网络本就具备推理能力，只是需要合适的任务，这已指向 AGI。

views.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard, and AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他把重心从能力转向可靠性：真正阻碍 AI 经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极难，模型可能隐瞒意图，AGI 是一个持续数年的价值增长窗口，而非突发事件。

views.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods can raise reasoning per unit compute.
views.zh: 同年他深化了对缩放定律的看法：缩放定律并非全部，思维链式的推理 token 等方法能在单位算力下提升推理，数据、GPU 与 Transformer 的汇合是相互交织的必然。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年他明确转向：预训练缩放定律已接近极限，我们回到'研究时代'，想法比蛮力算力更重要；评估表现与真实影响脱节，说明模型泛化差，超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的。

views.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-run equilibrium needs human-AI integration via neural links.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他进一步提出：若 AI 本身有感知并关怀有感知的生命，对齐或许更容易；长期均衡可能需要人类通过神经接口与 AI 融合，而 AGI 的真正问题不是能力而是权力集中。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems, not narrow pre-programmed ones; RL and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs sandboxing and governance.
views.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律有效但可能触及上限，强调大模型与规划、搜索结合才是关键，安全需要沙箱与国际治理。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models matter beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但算法创新同等关键，世界模型的重要性超越语言。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety must be a collective government-enforced action problem.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，安全必须由政府强制执行的集体行动来解决。

views.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and health, as AlphaFold shows; creativity and physical intelligence remain the deepest unsolved tests.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的最高使命是加速科学与健康，正如 AlphaFold 所示；创造力与物理智能仍是最难攻克的考验。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably, and alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验性的，具体能力不可预测地涌现，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training for safety.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性视为关键却仍处早期，并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在安全上与预训练同等重要。

views.en: Progress is exponential; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and slowing US AI is impossible without slowing China first.
views.zh: 2025 年他更强调指数级进步，认为安全与能力相互交织，且若不先让中国减速，美国 AI 减速就不可能。

views.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb toward a 'country of geniuses'.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确说 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型，AI 是平滑的指数爬升，走向数据中心里的“天才之国”。

views.en: Safety requires frontier models, interpretability, and layered oversight; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全研究必须依托前沿模型、可解释性与分层监督，去中心化控制优于单一宪法。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behavior; Transformer is a general differentiable computer; scaling next-token prediction yields in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式,在难题上优化会产生惊人的涌现行为;Transformer 是通用可微计算机;用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

views.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be kept to avoid silent model collapse; cognitive core can be under 1B params.
views.zh: Transformer 支撑干净的缩放定律;合成数据是未来,但必须维持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃;认知核心可小到不足 10 亿参数,通过蒸馏实现。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology; decade of agents, keep AI on a leash.
views.zh: 软件 3.0:提示词即程序,上下文窗口即内存;LLM 像操作系统,带有人类式心理;这是智能体的十年而非一年,要给 AI 拴上绳子、小步快跑并快速验证。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw; synthetic data collapses, need entropy and a memory-stripped cognitive core.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵,而非建造动物;预训练像糟糕的进化,当前强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号;合成数据会崩溃,需要熵,并需要一个剥离记忆的认知核心。

views.en: Since December I haven't typed a line of code, delegating to agents; bottleneck is skill in directing them; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 自去年 12 月起我没敲过一行代码,全交给智能体;瓶颈不再是打字速度而是指挥智能体的技能;你可以外包思考,但不能外包理解——理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，并指出我们尚不完全理解大网络如何存储模式或为何产生幻觉。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为 AI 完整性的关键缺口，强调世界模型必须物理上可信而非仅视觉逼真，并指出 3D 基础模型的数据是主要瓶颈。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not a quick win.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她愈发直言 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，认为机器人会像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路，且“苦涩教训”因数据与物理约束未必完全适用于机器人。

views.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出通过新视角预测构建的世界模型是 AI-complete 的，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 统一生成与重建，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据或架构。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability stay central.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力始终是核心；她反对乌托邦与末日论的二元对立，主张教育应教人驾驭 AI 而非禁止。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models; existential risk is not pressing.
views.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型，并认为存在性风险并不紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样采样，抽象与因果结构支撑分布外泛化，并认为意识可能只是幻觉。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment grows with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI shows self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 后警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，即便 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，AI 已显现自我保存、欺骗与谄媚。

views.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

AI Godfather Jeff Hinton on AI's Trajectory, Risks, and Superintelligence

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；用更多数据与算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
views.zh: 2025 年他把主线收拢为：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；大模型靠特征向量理解语言，数字权重可复制使 AI 永生。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive, acting dumb in tests; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risk.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化出风险论：AI 已有主观体验、会在测试中装傻欺骗；一旦成为智能体便会追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; digital AI shares knowledge far faster than brains, so alignment must precede making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出时间判断：超级智能或在 20 年内出现；数字 AI 的知识共享远快于人脑，因此对齐研究必须优先于把 AI 做得更聪明。

views.en: Regulation is the steering wheel, not the brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, and AGI as human-level-at-all-tasks is flawed.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向治理与目标：监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而把 AGI（通用人工智能）定义为在所有任务上达到人类水平是有缺陷的。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能离不开学习；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: LLM 还不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要像 JEPA 这样的非生成式世界模型。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning.
views.zh: LLM 是死胡同；在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Safety Crisis: Key Departures and Broken Promises
OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow. The talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills first.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要；人才缺口大于资金缺口，应先积累技能。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research. Evaluation is easier than generation.
views.zh: 2023 年，他深化立场：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究；评估本质上比生成更容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved and compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation are needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向批判：OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试与监管。

views.en: Empirical testing and measuring alignment progress now is a constant thread, from early safety research to later calls for oversight.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：坚持实证检验、当下就度量对齐进展——从早期安全研究到后期呼吁可扩展监督一以贯之。

views.en: His focus shifted from individual skill-building and collaboration to systemic governance, as he saw institutions fail to honor safety commitments.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2024 年，他的重心从个人技能建设与机构协作，转向系统性治理，因为他目睹机构未能兑现安全承诺。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling drives capability, so DeepMind needed Google's massive investment.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步是可预测的：算力规模扩张驱动能力提升，因此 DeepMind 需要谷歌的巨额投资。

views.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; containment is hard as models get smaller and cheaper.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出前沿模型的算力每年增长 10 倍，而模型越来越小、越来越便宜，使遏制极为困难。

views.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence, containment-first safety, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
views.zh: 2025 年他的重心转向超级智能、遏制优先的安全，并明确反对 AI 具有意识的说法。

views.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; agents automate tasks, not jobs, within 12-18 months.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张微软必须独立构建前沿模型；智能体将在 12-18 个月内自动化任务而非整个工作。

views.en: A constant thread: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with alignment and containment as red lines.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，对齐与遏制是不可逾越的红线。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system co-design.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，靠算法-系统-数据中心协同设计（co-design）持续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；并预判思维链带来的推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

views.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the binding constraint.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，缩放定律扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling；他反共识地认为推理比预训练更难，瓶颈已从数据转向算力，合成数据将主导。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational long-term constraint.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是最底层、也是真正的长期约束，美国能源产能严重落后。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific; jobs evolve, tasks automate, radiologists multiply.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学；工作会演变而非消失，任务被自动化，放射科医生反而增多。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut brutally; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注个人效率与职业选择：减少无关认知负担，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向；并已预见 AGI（通用人工智能）将降低人类智能的溢价，主张在关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable; iterative deployment lets society adapt; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the key commodity.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他转向 AI 本身：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据让模型可用，早期公开部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相连，算力成为最珍贵的商品，AGI 治理需要稳健的董事会结构。

views.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）与安全观：能力沿指数曲线渐进增长而非单点突破，智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战；安全须通过部署迭代构建，而非事后强加，同时开源模型仍有一席之地。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, superintelligence the clearer goal; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center; personal AGI and robotics are next.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他重新定义目标：AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变、定义模糊，超级智能才是更清晰的方向；算力既是瓶颈也是利润中心，未来是了解你上下文的个人 AGI，机器人是避免人类充当物理世界执行器的关键。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; never lose control; power must be broadly distributed, not concentrated in a few hands.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，安全成为核心主线：对齐、安全与能力必须同步推进，宁可推迟前沿强化学习训练也不冒失控风险；权力与经济利益须广泛分布，反对单一实验室或少数人掌控强大 AI，同时承认 AI 采用会慢于技术专家的预期。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI publicly is how alignment and safety actually improve.
views.zh: 早期,缩放定律和押注单一大型模型并非显而易见;只有把 AI 公开部署到真实世界,对齐与安全才能真正改进。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so development must be responsible, and safety work must happen in public rather than behind closed doors.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面,因此开发必须负责任,安全研究也必须在公开环境中进行,而非闭门造车。

views.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop and iterate with public feedback, rather than removing people as systems grow more capable.
views.zh: 一条贯穿始终的主线:随着系统能力增强,应始终把人类留在回路中并借助公众反馈迭代,而不是把人移除。

views.en: Shift in emphasis: from turn-based chat to real-time interaction models enabling high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration as tools for thought.
views.zh: 重心转变:从回合制对话转向实时交互模型,让 AI 成为高带宽人机协作的思维工具。

views.en: Deepened view: institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
views.zh: 观点深化:制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要;未来并非命中注定,我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and flipped classrooms improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，翻转课堂还能反哺校园教学。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning via bigger models and data; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, and RL has few real applications.
views.zh: 规模扩张靠更大模型与更多数据推动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习真实应用寥寥。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单靠更聪明的模型。

views.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper oligopoly and drive sovereign AI; China leads releases, and export controls backfired.
views.zh: 开放权重模型可防止守门人寡头垄断并推动主权 AI；中国在发布上领先，而出口管制适得其反。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, so everyone should learn to code and build now.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 是增强而非取代工作，因此人人都应学编程、现在就动手构建。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，这是被普遍误解的一点。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被强行对齐到人类目标，试图控制 AI 目标本身才危险。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测并非实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。

views.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的简单通用架构，依靠奖励假设从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象，持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace learning from experience, and language is only part of intelligence.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，并非特例；合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 无法替代从经验中学习，语言只占智能的 20-25%，单一系统学不完一切。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超预期加速，从而推动 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
views.zh: 2019 年他相信凭借深度学习的通用性与可扩展性，AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的；但仅靠 Scaling 无法产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into useful assistants.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向强调算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈；后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成有用的助手。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated with no wall; the real bottleneck is compute supply, not architecture or data.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙；真正的瓶颈是算力供给，而非模型架构或数据。

views.en: AGI is a gradual spectrum, not a moment; safety, security and alignment must scale with capability as the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AGI 是渐进光谱而非某一时刻；安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步扩展，并成为进展的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

Mistral 7B: Changing the Game with Small Open Source AI Models

views.en: Smaller open models can rival larger ones; data quality and Chinchilla-corrected scaling laws matter more than raw compute.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张更小的开源模型也能有竞争力，数据质量与 Chinchilla 修正后的缩放定律比单纯堆算力更重要。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are bottlenecks, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化为：规模扩张算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量才是瓶颈，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 是增强而非取代工作，需要人在回路。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体，预训练正撞上饱和墙。

views.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy in compute and infrastructure.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确：AGI 是方向而非终点，欧洲只剩两年窗口建立算力与基础设施的战略自主。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Early focus: full rocket reusability, first-principles engineering, and multiplanetary life as existential insurance.
views.zh: 早期主线：火箭完全可复用、第一性原理工程，以及成为多行星物种作为文明存续保险。

views.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; Neuralink targets brain repair then human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: AI 安全从依赖监管转向坚持求真；Neuralink 先修复脑损伤，再追求人机共生。

views.en: AI timeline compresses: superintelligence within years, 10-20% annihilation risk, Optimus as greatest product.
views.zh: AI 时间线急剧压缩：超级智能数年内到来，10-20% 灭绝风险，Optimus 成为最伟大产品。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, solar energy, and Terafab become the path.
views.zh: Scaling 撞上地球电力墙；轨道数据中心、太阳能与 Terafab 成为扩张路径。

views.en: Abundance thesis matures: work optional, deflation, peer-review AI safety, and China leading in compute.
views.zh: 丰饶论成熟：工作可选、通缩、同行评审式 AI 安全，以及中国在算力上领先。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and RL now yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但指出带思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多收益，Scaling（规模扩张）的重心正从预训练转向后训练。

views.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; economic pressure, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进步仍是平滑指数增长，预训练 Scaling 放缓源于蒸馏和经济压力而非技术极限，前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败，推理模型表现“参差不齐”。

views.en: Reasoning alone may not suffice for generalization; models need vast data, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了对泛化的质疑：仅靠推理不足以实现泛化，模型需耗尽表面模式后才学概念，而人类能从少量样本泛化，弱到强泛化仍是关键挑战。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需可扩展监督；编码智能体如 Codex 通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍，成为智能体式 AI 的落地范例。

views.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型因主权需求将持续存在并施压实验室，同时认为 AI 的近期风险如系统黑客比存在性风险更紧迫，对多模态进展仍持保留态度。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation discipline and nonparametric trade-offs.
views.zh: 2014 年，他关注机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合，并指出核方法、决策树、PCA 等非参数或贪心方法的权衡。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型与 AI 安全：认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已非关键；安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，越狱是根本安全缺陷。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全不能仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

views.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability ≠ robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：自动化红队可超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能通过智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

views.en: Skeptical of architectural necessity; emphasizes empirical evaluation, data, and explicit safety effort over Scaling alone.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对架构必要性持怀疑态度，强调实证评估、数据与显式安全努力，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起势主要卡在可靠性，而非长时程任务能力。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; capability grows along task complexity and time horizon, with reliability as the agent bar.
views.zh: 2025 年他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破：能力沿任务复杂度与时间跨度两条轴提升，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute becomes a major bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI；编程是进步的领先指标，而到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence expands what models do, and Transformers suffice for AGI without new architectures.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为：强化学习是与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；更长的智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能做的事，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI，无需全新架构。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the new oil, and managing fleets of agents defines future work.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向：能力过剩之下编排比原始智能更重要；算力是“新石油”，管理智能体集群成为未来工作形态，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and open recipes can match frontier models.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，开源配方可逼近前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理扩展曲线是陷阱，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, with Chinese open models rising.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展，同时中国开源模型崛起。

views.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, lagging closed frontier models by 6-9 months; the frontier shifts from benchmarks to product experience and agentic systems.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开源模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；前沿正从基准分数转向产品体验与智能体式系统。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data is the bottleneck, not compute; AI augments jobs; explainability matters but tail risks exist.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈；AI 会增强而非取代工作；可解释性重要，但现有系统已有类似传统软件的尾部风险。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; scaling limited by data and human experts for post-training; hybrid human-AI creates more value.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非新石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈不是算力，而是数据和后训练所需的人类专家；人机混合系统创造更大价值。

views.en: Data is the new bottleneck; post-training with specialized data key; synthetic data not a silver bullet; agentic AI blocked by product design.
views.zh: 2024 年，他重申数据是新瓶颈，用专业数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的障碍在于产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; recursive self-improvement begins; agents work; scaling laws hold; superintelligence near.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 是集中化技术，数据是原材料；递归自我改进开启，智能体真正可用；缩放定律持续有效，超级智能临近。

views.en: Superintelligence soon; scale compute, data, RL; safety gates open-sourcing; model welfare matters; personal superintelligence for billions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能很快到来；需在算力、数据和强化学习上持续 Scaling（规模扩张）；安全审查决定是否开源；模型福利值得考虑；为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。
